payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methods for incorporating section titles into the BOS representation in the HiStruct+ model.

claims.text: Section titles are incorporated into the BOS representation by using section title embeddings (STE) or classified section title embeddings (classified STE).
The STE is generated by feeding the tokenized section title into the TLM and summing the last hidden states, while classified STE replaces intraclass STEs with a class embedding.
Section titles are used as additional hierarchical structure information to enrich sentence representations in the HiStruct+ model.
